第1集 - 獅子: 最乾燥的莽原
programme.desc: 莽原上的獅子想在夜晚狩獵, 但牠們平常鎖定的獵物都在白日活動, 所以牠們只能頂著高溫, 和獵物搏鬥。

programme.title: 第4集 - 黑幫主題
programme.desc: 金柏莉和傑瑞米最先是養貓, 並且用黑幫人物「幸運盧西安諾」來取名, 所以他們後來開始養蛇, 就繼續從黑幫人物裡挑名字, 來搭配不同蛇種的個性。他們希望葛雷格幫他們打造黑幫主題的陸生缸, 並且結合禁酒時期主題。葛雷格的團隊想到用酒桶堆疊, 每個酒桶打造成不同黑幫人物的背景, 然後堆疊起來, 成為一個大型爬蟲箱, 成為傑瑞米和金柏莉客廳裡搶眼的擺飾。

programme.title: 第13集 - 德州傳奇烏龜
programme.desc: 卡悠提對動物的熱愛, 始於一種行蹤飄忽的爬行類動物, 叫做鱷龜。

programme.title: 第8集 - 烏鴉惡兆
programme.desc: 2018年2月14在華盛頓州西雅圖, 一大群烏鴉聚集在一起, 而且都在看同一隻烏鴉,, 這會是傳說中的烏鴉葬禮嗎?

programme.title: 第9集 - 章魚脫逃大師
programme.desc: 在厄瓜多叢林的中心地帶, 有種小鳴鳥是傳奇動物, 牠會用神秘的技巧發出叫聲。

programme.title: 第6集 - 防禦
programme.desc: 在野外求生的動物, 一定要強化自己的防衛能力。有些動物會躲進群體裡尋求庇護, 有些動物則會躲到不見蹤影, 還有些動物的防衛之道就是強力反擊。

programme.title: 第1集 - 總統的家犬
programme.desc: 無論是家畜、野生動物、禮物或是家族寵物, 動物長久以來都是華府的住戶。但什麼狗最適合當總統愛犬?雷根總統那隻差點害自己喪命的騎士查理王獵犬?或是讓最高統帥流下男兒淚的狗?又或是羅斯福那隻的咬破政要褲子而出了名的德國牧羊犬?本集節目將為你介紹著名的美國總統愛犬, 以及這些狗狗為何適合當國際領導人最好的同伴。

programme.title: 第2集 - 就愛撒嬌
programme.desc: 什麼樣的狗才是最完美的人類夥伴?對主人忠心耿耿?喜歡擁抱和親吻?或是那楚楚可憐的臉蛋?在本集的《狗狗101》, 我們將為您介紹最惹人疼愛的狗狗。無論是忠心的黃金獵犬、活潑的愛爾蘭軟毛梗、黏人的荷蘭毛獅狗, 甚至是短小精悍的北京狗, 這些親和的犬種堪稱是理想的家庭犬, 但究竟是什麼優點讓牠們成為人類最完美的夥伴呢?

programme.title: 第11集 - 賓蒂最好孕
programme.desc: 澳洲動物園再度嘗試讓鶴鴕交配, 這種瀕危動物生性火爆, 讓保育員傷透腦筋。母鶴鴕生下蛋以後, 眾人都引頸期盼它們是否能成功孵化。和羅伯特一起長大的短吻鱷安德烈即將告別鱷劇場, 去潟湖享受退休生活, 由年輕的歐布隆接棒演出。賓蒂和錢德勒期待寶貝女兒的誕生。

programme.title: 第1集 - 花招百出
programme.desc: From a shoplifting Husky to a parrot that cusses like a sailor Bad Dog! documents just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love.

programme.title: 第4集 - 西伯利亞虎之鄉

programme.title: 第12集 - Why Raeliana Ended Up At The Duke's Mansion
programme.desc: 努爾拜訪了現今國王, 也是他的異母哥哥希亞托里希。當他終於開口提到自己與萊利娜所締結之契約, 希亞托里希當面指出, 現在議會會期即將結束, 應該已不再需要這個婚約的事實。與此同時, 萊利娜前往溫奈特家墓地, 貝兒托利絲是否會如同小說所描寫的一樣出現呢?

programme.title: 第12集 - Tokyo Blade
programme.desc: 舞台劇《東京BLADE》的排練開始了。阿奎亞將自己的演技也當作了調查小愛喪命真相的手段。然而LALALAI首席演員．姬川的存在, 帶給了所有演員極大的刺激...!?

programme.title: 第21集 - The Scaffold At Last! The Way To Ace Has Opened!
programme.desc: 魯夫無意識釋放出「霸王色霸氣」阻止了二次處刑, 白鬍子與隊長們、三上將及卡普都為此感到震驚。而魯夫只一心朝著處刑台奔跑!白鬍子喝令全員全力支援魯夫!

programme.title: 第22集 - Each On Different Paths! Luffy Vs. Garp!
programme.desc: 潛伏在伊娃柯夫頭髮裡的雷電利用「剪剪果實」的能力, 搭建了通往處刑台的橋樑。在魯夫衝上橋時, 卡普擋在了面前!身為魯夫的爺爺同時也是海軍本部中將, 他的腦海中閃過過往歲月, 兩人隨即展開激烈衝突!

programme.title: 第54集 - Beginning Of The Night's End
programme.desc: 亞連被困在陷入降咎狀態的斯曼體內, 與其本體相遇。亞連勸說他停止破壞行為, 但對方對驅魔師和神明懷恨在心, 毫不聽勸。白色巨大物體正接近, 使村子危在旦夕。亞連從斯曼體內逃出後, 試圖全力釋放自己的INNOCENCE之力以阻擋對方危害村子。

programme.title: 第55集 - Howl
programme.desc: 亞連無法阻止陷入降咎狀態的斯曼失控, 村子因此遭破壞焚毀, 四處逃竄的百姓悲痛欲絕。斯曼聽到一個男孩因父母死去的心碎哭聲後恢復自我。然而, 他的失控並未停止, 還破壞得更慘烈。此時亞連由於釋放了全力, 左手無法動彈, 無能為力的他陷入絕望中。

programme.desc: 舞台劇《東京BLADE》的排練開始了。阿奎亞將自己的演技也當作了調查小愛喪命真相的手段。然而LALALAI首席演員．姬川的存在, 帶給了所有演員極大的刺激...!?

programme.title: 第54集 - Beginning Of The Night's End
programme.desc: 亞連被困在陷入降咎狀態的斯曼體內, 與其本體相遇。亞連勸說他停止破壞行為, 但對方對驅魔師和神明懷恨在心, 毫不聽勸。白色巨大物體正接近, 使村子危在旦夕。亞連從斯曼體內逃出後, 試圖全力釋放自己的INNOCENCE之力以阻擋對方危害村子。

programme.title: 第55集 - Howl
programme.desc: 亞連無法阻止陷入降咎狀態的斯曼失控, 村子因此遭破壞焚毀, 四處逃竄的百姓悲痛欲絕。斯曼聽到一個男孩因父母死去的心碎哭聲後恢復自我。然而, 他的失控並未停止, 還破壞得更慘烈。此時亞連由於釋放了全力, 左手無法動彈, 無能為力的他陷入絕望中。

programme.title: 第11集 - Why Raeliana Feigned Ignorance
programme.desc: 女僕告誡萊利娜千萬不能去看位於西館深處的鏡子。因為有傳聞說若和鏡中魂四目交接, 它就會告訴來者任何事情。但萊利娜想知道小說女主角貝兒托利絲的所在, 仍在夜晚拿起了鏡子。當奇怪的聲音嚇得萊利娜縮起身體時, 出現在她面前的竟不是鏡中魂, 而是努爾。

programme.title: 第12集 - Why Raeliana Ended Up At The Duke's Mansion
programme.desc: 努爾拜訪了現今國王, 也是他的異母哥哥希亞托里希。當他終於開口提到自己與萊利娜所締結之契約, 希亞托里希當面指出, 現在議會會期即將結束, 應該已不再需要這個婚約的事實。與此同時, 萊利娜前往溫奈特家墓地, 貝兒托利絲是否會如同小說所描寫的一樣出現呢?

programme.title: 第55集 - Howl
programme.desc: 亞連無法阻止陷入降咎狀態的斯曼失控, 村子因此遭破壞焚毀, 四處逃竄的百姓悲痛欲絕。斯曼聽到一個男孩因父母死去的心碎哭聲後恢復自我。然而, 他的失控並未停止, 還破壞得更慘烈。此時亞連由於釋放了全力, 左手無法動彈, 無能為力的他陷入絕望中。

programme.title: 第56集 - Delete
programme.desc: 看到斯曼突然死去後亞連感到震驚, 此時有名神秘男人帝奇出現在他面前。亞連認出眼前的男人是諾亞一族的成員, 於是發動猛攻。對方躲開後用手臂貫穿亞連的胸口, 但神奇的是傷口既無痛感也未流血。接著能夠穿透物體並碰到目標物的帝奇將手伸向亞連的心臟。

programme.title: 第24集 - Blackout
programme.desc: 魔法騎士團的成員受到強大的空間魔法影響而憑空消失。當下及時反應過來的尤諾順利逃脫後, 與魔力強大的凱薩琳陷入交戰局面。敵人射出的咒彈讓他的身體漸漸失去知覺, 不甘心的尤諾此時發現自己的魔產生的變化。面對逃過一劫的亞斯塔等人, 拉迪斯卻顯得從容。

programme.title: 第25集 - Adversity
programme.desc: 費根雷翁團長在亞斯塔等人的面前被空間魔法捕獲並消失。諾艾兒從發動的魔法性質推測出施術者就在附近。亞斯塔揭開主使者的真面目後, 眾人目睹了不敢置信的景象。此時尤諾在風之精靈希爾芙的幫助下重創凱薩琳, 她轉而攻擊剛好在場的黑色暴牛團成員恰咪。

programme.desc: 波爾基烏斯試圖以尼貝利姆託付給他的強大力量控制周圍, 將奧偍瑪蒂亞從緋紅的異空間救出來。但一名應該早就被打倒的男人, 突然從奇美拉之中出現, 擋住他的去路。在翼之血族走投無路時, 卡姆想起了讓他嘗到敗仗的殺盡龍, 基爾賽雅, 那是個與他不分軒輊的強者。

programme.desc: 佳賢母子和慧敏母女一起來到慧敏媽媽的出生地-邦喀島。

programme.title: 第3集 - 蜂蜜
programme.desc: 主持人為了瞭解蜂蜜的製作過程, 親自到養蜂場體驗採蜜, 最後再以蜂蜜料理緬懷一位會養蜂的廚師朋友。

programme.title: 第4集 - 米飯
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 凱蒂探索各種不同在地小農種植的米粒, 親自下田採收稻米, 並在節目的最後, 用此行的收穫準備兩道美味料理, 西班牙燉飯與米布丁。

programme.title: 第5集 - 吉隆坡
programme.desc: 本集節目由主持人文杰與DJ卡卡以及網紅Henn一起閒逛吉隆坡, 他們到茨廠街吃美食、體驗文化, 參觀了印度廟和仙四師爺廟, 吃了麻芝、曼煎糕和加央蛋糕捲等甜點, 也做了袖珍模型, 最後以福建麵和月光河這樣的道地美食當宵夜, 結束美好的行程...

programme.title: 第6集 - 霹靂

programme.title: 第7集
programme.desc: Korean actor Lee Sinyoung travels across Japan, interacting with local people as he seeks out 'soul food.' Korea and Japan, with their distinct cultures.

programme.desc: Korean actor Lee Sinyoung travels across Japan, interacting with local people as he seeks out 'soul food.' Korea and Japan, with their distinct cultures.

programme.title: 第1集 - 夏許立克餐廳
programme.desc: 主持人在本集中的共餐夥伴是名廚李尚濱, 她帶他去她小時候常和父母去的俄式餐廳「夏許利克」。

programme.title: 第2集 - 東興與花生湯圓
programme.desc: 名廚李尚濱在本集帶領著主持人到歷史悠久的東興餅店, 吃了美味的蛋塔和目前已經沒有在販賣的獨門料理。

programme.title: 第6集 - 日本進貢的藻鹽
programme.desc: Once offered to Japanese emperors, moshio, or seaweed salt, is a living heritage; with the complex taste of ocean minerals and deep umami in a single grain.

programme.title: 第6集 - 九皇齋節
programme.desc: 九皇齋節是泰國著名的素食節, 期間除了各式儀式活動, 當然也少不了各種齋菜。

programme.title: 第2集 - 香料烤豬
programme.desc: 使用特調香料醃製的董里烤豬不僅是一道美食, 更是當地文化重要的一部分。

programme.title: 第1集 - 國民食堂
programme.desc: We explore Singapore's hawker culture through heartfelt stories of veteran hawkers and their successors and purpose that have shaped the trade.

programme.title: 第9集 - 梁
programme.desc: 住在澤西城的梁家是華裔家庭, 兩個女兒因為想念爸媽做的家常菜而開立美食部落格, 詳細記錄每道家常菜的做法。家族其他成員也會提供他們的家常料理食譜。週末是梁家一同做菜並享用晚餐的時候, 全家會先去超市買食材、在超市熟食區吃完午餐後回家開始料理。安德魯則是為晚餐做了一道泰式椰汁雞湯。

programme.title: 第10集 - 平賀羅
programme.desc: 安德魯受邀到紐澤西州納特利小鎮上的平賀羅家吃晚餐。三代同堂的平賀羅一家祖父母是葡萄牙移民, 家族常常舉辦派對聚餐, 讓新生代從小就耳濡目染家族傳統及飲食習慣。家裡每個成員都有自己的拿手好菜, 安德魯做的披披醬蝦也獲得家中奶奶的認可。

programme.title: 第10集
programme.desc: 在最後一集節目中, 阿賢與林德榮帶著媽媽們前往充滿歷史氣息的台南安平, 並享用古早味十足的辦桌菜。

programme.title: 第5集 - 如何配對

programme.desc: 阿拉伯沙漠,傳說中充滿沙丘和烈日的遼闊景色,橫跨八國,佔地上百萬平方哩,一年降雨量不到四吋,氣溫高達華氏120度以上. 數世紀以來,它始終被認為是世界上最不適合居住的環境之一. 古往今來,只有當地的貝都因人能適應在這片荒蕪的土地上生活. 然而對不熟悉沙漠的人來說,生存就成了難以捉摸的死亡遊戲. 本集節目中,喬和寇迪來到中東的阿曼,在無盡的阿拉伯沙漠中孤立無援. 他們必須對抗太陽,沙丘和酷熱,以及有毒的掠食動物. 體溫過高和脫水是他們最大的敵人. 他們遵循貝都因遊牧民族的方式,才能活著走出這座死亡沙漠.

programme.title: 第6集 - 受傷頻傳

programme.title: 第7集 - 紀律為重
programme.desc: 白令海進入秋末, 一個暴風雨才剛走, 另一個就要來了, 船隊趕忙填滿配額, 設法避開即將來襲的暴風雨。西北號在船隊西方50哩處, 艾德格韓森船長遇上北極風暴前緣, 他急著再抓12萬磅的螃蟹, 所以他必須在滔滔白浪中尋找螃蟹聚集地, 然而船員擔心暴風雨危及自身的安全, 他們決定越過艾德格向席格求助。返回港口後, 布蘭納號的年輕船長尚恩杜爾得知他的朋友兼船員波那沒有大礙, 於是他們重新出海回到之前的熱點, 並再次在那裡補到大量的螃蟹。

programme.title: 第8集 - 要命的大浪
programme.desc: 本季最大的暴風雨即將來襲, 率先遇上這個北極颶風的尚恩杜爾船長率領船員艱辛地在大浪之中收籠子, 為了顧及船員的安全, 即便還沒填滿配額, 尚恩還是決定返港, 傑克安德森等人被迫返回港口修理船隻, 兩週過去, 船還是沒有修好, 為了把握剩餘的時間, 傑克靈機一動想出折衷的法子。野人比爾船長同樣冒著大風大浪設置籠子, 然而強勁風浪把浮筒往船身推, 導致舵輪被籠子纏住, 為了安全起見, 野人比爾決定暫時不收籠子, 他們要先回港口解開纏住的繩子。

programme.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan S5E4 -Bedrock Bottom
Outback Opal Hunters S8E15 -In The Trenches
第3集 - Sports, Shoes, Ocean Water, Tea And More
programme.desc: 全世界知名品牌, 都尋求台灣專業製造商的協助, 使用立體模型技術, 設計前衛新潮的鞋類。一隻鞋的獨立組成部分可高達20種, 每一種都要符合特定的配色設計。他們要製作各式各樣的織物, 網布和填料。在球場外, 台灣有一位偉大的棒球無名英雄, 投身於製作完美的客製精品棒球套, 時間超過40年。手套的有四個獨立組件, 那些就是外皮、內裡、墊片和網布。台灣是世界上消耗茶葉很大的市場, 這家工廠位於台灣北部, 滿足當地品茶行家已有100年之久。在世界上許多地方, 茶葉一年採收兩次, 然而由於台灣的氣候溫和, 有些品種每年可以採收五次, 幾乎終年都有收穫。台灣海洋深層水公司, 是亞洲開發海洋水源最大的公司, 公司團隊從海洋深處開發水源, 製作各式各樣的保健品。有一家公司製作的電鍋, 數十年來已成為台灣的集體烹飪記憶, 電鍋到現在已經是有50多個年頭了, 它的基本的設計理念, 就是要讓男女老少都非常好用, 然後只需要一個按鍵。目前在台灣的大街小巷有1千4百萬輛機車左右, 台灣的氣候溫和, 車身很小的機車, 往往在全島是最快最經濟的代步工具。在高雄的這一家工廠, 準備進行每天的生產過程。

programme.title: 第23集 - 特效雪
programme.desc: 本集介紹三種物品的製造原理: 電漿寶石、特效雪與鋼琴修整。首先的電漿寶石不是天然開採出的寶石, 而是用垃圾做出來。使用電漿科技, 把有機廢棄物轉變成能源, 無機廢棄物中的金屬可回收利用, 金屬氧化物則變成黑色玻璃, 可在加工後變成美麗珠寶。第二種是大自然不從人願時, 影視拍攝會用造雪機製造出的假雪, 它們其實是微小的肥皂泡, 在攝影機前逼真得令人驚奇。最後是修復複雜的鋼琴。其經過長久歲月, 材質與零件會隨著劣化, 因此修整是延繫它壽命的方法。修整團隊必須拆卸所有零件, 可修復的部分需要清潔、除銹、或是去除表面漆, 然後砂磨處理表面, 使它煥然一新。不能修復的部分, 則需要依原有規格, 做出複製品, 並一再調整, 才不會造成與其他部位的大幅落差。過程可能需要好幾星期, 但這是考驗技術, 也是出自對鋼琴的熱愛。

programme.title: 第24集 - 電動三輪車
programme.desc: 1895年小奧格登波頓在美國註冊第一台電動三輪車的專利, 一百年之後它們成為全世界最受歡迎的電動交通工具, 電動三輪車蔚為風潮, 因為結合人體工學設計以及尖端機械工程。對付乾燥皮膚最好的方式就是塗抹潤膚乳, 它能活化皮膚細胞宛如一層保護屏障, 這一點在冬天特別重要, 抗癌藥物也會讓皮膚變乾硬, 因此擦乳液很重要。戶外暖器可以讓你在室外用餐即使天氣很冷, 並且在寒冷的夏天晚上增添暖意, 讓你在露台休憩的季節延長到秋天, 這種模式能讓熱氣從四面八方發散。早期車輛的輪胎有木輻和輪圈, 但到了1920年製造商開始採用比較持久的材質, 例如鐵和鋼, 目前木輻輪被用於經典車翻新, 製造商先生產包裹木輪胎的鋼鐵輪圈, 花16小時才打造出有懷舊風格的輪胎。

programme.title: 第3集 - 鉛筆,球棒與烤模
programme.desc: 田納西州的鉛筆之都在全盛時期曾有多間工廠, 歷久不衰的馬斯格雷夫公司, 至今仍繼續傳承這個具有深遠歷史的產物；過去不被看好的蛋糕烤模, 在一次烘培比賽中脫穎而出後成為家家戶戶不可或缺的廚具；一窺職棒大聯盟御用球棒製造商的製作過程, 展現練就多年的好手藝, 並體會當地人對於棒球的熱愛。

programme.title: 第4集 - 雷根糖,霓虹燈與滑雪板
programme.desc: 吉利貝出產許多種糖果和甜食, 其中最受歡迎的就是你我都愛的雷根糖。在糖果工廠, 各種風味的糖漿灌入模具、裹上糖粉, 形成具有嚼勁的糖心, 最後披上一層糖衣, 閃亮甜蜜的雷根糖等著你來品嘗。復古的霓虹燈, 不論白天黑夜, 都為美國大街小巷增添光彩, 形成一種獨特風情。西岸霓虹1985年在西雅圖發跡, 玻璃、氣體和電流的化學反應造就炫彩奪目的霓虹藝術, 這項技藝永不過時。從白雪靄靄的山頭向下衝刺, 腳上踩的滑雪板結合了衝浪板及傳統滑雪板設計而成。採用頂級木材製成的木芯, 工匠嚴謹的做工和外觀與性能兼具的設計, 「永無夏日」滑雪板成了每個滑雪玩家的夢幻逸品。

programme.title: 第9集 - 特種部隊
programme.desc: 特種作戰是軍隊的成功要素, 包括執行破壞行動、人質救援, 到消滅高價目標, 例如賓拉登, 都需要特種部隊。他們在高風險、非傳統戰爭的最前線, 受訓用極端武力打擊敵軍, 或是悄悄靠近, 隱密而精確地獵殺。特種部隊精通戰爭方法媲美世界上任何其他作戰部隊, 在現今的政治環境中, 美軍對他們和他們使用的武器, 仰賴程度超乎史上其他時刻。特種作戰最關鍵的武器, 不是攻擊步槍或武裝直升機, 也不是炸藥或攻擊船艇, 而是操作這些裝備的精英士兵--特種部隊本身就是最致命的武器。

programme.title: 第12集 - 神秘紅雨
programme.desc: 本集介紹一場神秘的紅雨, 我們能像訓練小狗一樣訓練人類嗎?以及發現輻射危害的工廠女工。

programme.title: 第11集 - 蝸牛,餐具,輕艇
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 介紹了食用蝸牛、叉子和小輕艇的製作。野外捕獲的蝸牛, 要送入加工廠, 經清洗、去殼、去腸、煮熟和冷凍後, 便能裝箱送出。叉子的原料不鏽鋼, 是將鉻鐵與鋼經處理後結合的成品；原料送至加工廠後, 由模具壓出叉齒, 再扳成彎曲的形狀, 拋光後便完成。本集介紹的小輕艇是專為釣魚而設計, 具備特殊的動力鰭板, 模仿水中動物的動作, 裝在聚乙烯打造的船身中央, 可自行在水中前進而不需劃動。

programme.title: 第11集 - 機械爪,調味劑,狗雪橇,運動鞋
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹機械爪、調味劑、狗雪橇和運動鞋的製造原理。機械爪可以抓運大型物件, 也能藉由電磁鐵吸取較小物件, 大約需要各有不同形狀與厚薄的50塊金屬製成, 藉由模板塑形, 再進行焊接。調味劑是日常用品之一, 化學家會以極其繁多的成份創造出各種配方, 依照客戶需求做出調整, 之後進行一系列的檢驗。雪橇如今已成為一項運動, 所有部件必須像拼圖一樣相互咬合, 再進行組裝。運動鞋輕量又耐用, 得先以型模壓切在合成纖維上製成鞋底, 再切裁各種皮革, 進行車縫, 最後將鞋材在鞋楦上拉伸定型。

programme.title: 第5集 - 技壓全場
programme.desc: 在本集節目中, 我們請到一群頂尖的科學天才, 為大家解碼分析20部熱門影片。包含在土耳其拉凡谷挑戰走繩的勇士、網路神槍手22普林斯特要用一發子彈點燃火柴、山貓直升機在洶湧海洋上成功迫降、大馬士革刀再現江湖。以及摩艾石像移動理論、只靠雙腳攀巖的男人、還有用手就能製作泳鏡的奇人等等, 科學天才將逐一解釋其中的原理。

第6集 - 柴油引擎藍寶堅尼
programme.desc: 在萬威柴油車廠, 切斯等人要繼續完成這輛2004年的藍寶堅尼。

programme.title: 第4集 - 時尚警察
programme.desc: 艾利斯在夜店碰到一位客戶亞歷斯范海森, 他經營模特兒經紀公司, 並提議跟柏林廠合作舉辦今年時尚週的搖滾時尚夜, 地點就利用柏林廠, 萊恩跟艾利斯同意, 並決定用改裝警車來做為這次合作改裝車輛的主題。艾利斯在柏林附近看到一輛雪佛蘭老爺車, 提議用它來改裝成時尚夜警車, 不過, 乍看之下, 萊恩簡直嚇了一大跳, 對還沒有經驗的柏林新手團隊而言, 這項改裝工程是一項大挑戰。尤其是, 在改裝過程中, 萊恩邀請日本老友哈地齊, 與艾利斯和梅根一同前往埃森車展, 看看歐洲目前最新的車款, 不過, 在柏林零下16度的低溫下, 留在廠裡的團隊卻進度遲緩, 艾利斯回來發現, 簡直怒不可遏, 萊恩也決定從加州請來大丹, 好好整頓一下柏林廠的紀律, 時尚夜當晚, 改裝警車能夠如期完成嗎?

programme.title: 第3集 - 雪怪出擊
programme.desc: 介紹阿拉斯加的大機具。以冰河風號為代表的拉型拖船、破冰機「雪怪機」等。

programme.title: 第5集 - 擦身而過
programme.desc: 上週堪薩斯車手挑戰中央密蘇里賽道, 卻是鎩羽而歸。本週回到家園, 繼續積分賽的爭奪。湯姆對提姆下戰帖, 為了要在錐道計時賽中一拚高下, 還特別情商友人, 借來全鋁合金底盤的蓮花跑車, 要在兩人都不熟悉的領域, 繼續彼此的競爭；丹尼努力培植下一代車手, 請來專業人士到場相助, 要讓年僅16歲的車手艾潔泰斯, 一次增加十年的功力, 而艾潔隨後參與賽事, 也不負眾望跑出了個人賽車生涯中的最佳成績；克林特鮑爾現為全美房車賽史普林盃車手, 而他也是從本地的沙地賽道出身, 與提姆等車手都是舊識, 這次回娘家, 也給了提姆賽車的建議；丹尼撞壞的主要賽車, 本週將重新登場, 而邦尼借用組員的引擎, 但車況還是有問題, 苦於找不出癥結所在。

programme.title: 第5集 - 超級買賣
programme.desc: 客戶克里斯委託車廠改造一輛電玩禮車, 安迪不會放過賺錢的機會, 他說服克里斯改造一輛電玩巴士, 用來招攬更多生意, 一筆小生意就為安迪帶來更多的生意。安迪收藏的挑戰者馬力不足, 他希望能升級馬力, 老爸鮑伯接下這個任務之後才發現, 他要找到技師沒那麼容易, 他可以向安迪證明自己寶刀未老嗎?

programme.title: 第7集 - 日歐融合
programme.desc: 本集介紹了當前流行的混搭融合風格。埃米爾也趁機將自己的蓮花跑車, 進行了一番大改造。

programme.title: 第15集 - 漏油問題
programme.desc: 女子修車手們為一台到處都在漏油的水星美洲獅解決了漏油問題, 卻發現還有其他難解的問題, 因此這次無法順利把車完全修好交回給車主。

programme.title: 第3集 - 沙漠尋寶
programme.desc: 史帝夫馬納提來到經典美製老車迷酷愛的漠谷汽車零件場, 研究1970年代環境部減排令對肌肉車風潮的影響。

programme.desc: 在萬威柴油車廠, 切斯等人要繼續完成這輛2004年的藍寶堅尼。

programme.title: 30 Minute Meals S28E14 -A Cutlet Above
programme.desc: Rachael Ray reinvents the everyday pork cutlet with her Pork Tonkatsu with Shiso and Savoy.

programme.title: 第14集 - 肉排料理
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 瑞秋要做日式炸豬排, 她發現只要做成肉片, 無論是酥炸肉排或帕瑪乳酪烤雞排, 往往都會大獲好評。她先開始使用烏斯特黑醋、番茄醬、醬油、芥末粉、蒜粒與味醂調製出美味可口的醬汁, 接著準備好裹料的烤盤, 把豬腰肉排打扁後裹上日式麵包粉、蛋液及芝麻, 用中性油下鍋炸得酥香可口, 淋上已經做好的醬汁, 讓她免了去日式餐廳排對外帶回家吃的麻煩, 在家就能享用這道美食。她接著把皺葉甘藍切絲, 加上蘿蔔片與紫蘇絲, 做了一道速成的沙拉, 淋上溜醬油及蜂蜜做成的醬汁, 味道非常甘甜。

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing S1E7 -Shift 7: Simplicity
programme.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi start hour 18 by testing the bruised, battered and exhausted chefs on their simplicity, one of the most difficult techniques to master.

programme.title: 第7集 - 第七輪:簡潔
programme.desc: 接續著上一集, 本集揭曉了馬塞爾和馬泰爾的對決結果, 最後是馬塞爾獲勝, 馬泰爾被淘汰出局。

programme.title: Man V. Food S4E25 -Scottsdale Arizona
programme.desc: Casey Webb's culinary quest brings him to Scottsdale, AZ, where he crunches a sweet Latin staple and tackles on a Stone Age feast.

programme.title: 第25集 - 亞利桑那州斯科次代爾
programme.desc: 本集凱西偉伯來到亞利桑那州的斯科次代爾, 品嘗超狂早午餐、可以客製化的吉拿棒, 最後挑戰在三十分鐘內, 吃完一般人要花一整天才吃得完的熟食套餐。

programme.title: Man V. Food S4E26 -Denver Colorado
programme.desc: Casey Webb's eating expedition brings him to Denver for a mile-high fried chicken biscuit, a bowl of brisket and gravy-topped latkes.

programme.title: 第26集 - 科羅拉多州丹佛
programme.desc: 在本集節目中, 主持人凱西來到丹佛, 他將品嘗丹佛小麵包公司的特色小麵包三明治, 見識薯餅之愛餐廳的猶太風薯餅料理, 並征服山姆三號店, 重達1.8公斤的早餐怪獸。他是否能在30分鐘內挑戰成功呢?鎖定本節目觀賞精彩內容。

programme.title: Best Places To Pig Out S1E1 -Pizza, Pork, Pancakes!
programme.desc: The most unique and over-the-top places to pig out in America are highlighted.

programme.desc: 本集要介紹全美最獨特、最浮誇的狂吃地點。

programme.desc: As perfect pairs week continues, contestants must work together to create four servings of a dessert inspired by the iconic Reese's Peanut Butter Cup.

programme.title: 第26集
programme.desc: 隨著完美搭配周的持續進行, 參賽者必須合作創造四份受標誌性瑞茲花生醬杯啟發的甜點。

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: 大象傳奇
programme.desc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E1 -Einstein Must Go!
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: 第1集 - 愛因斯坦必須離開！
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧：雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒，八隻雌獅，十頭年輕的獅子，以及愛因斯坦，那頭從未離開家園、如今已長成的幼獅。當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵，最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時，為他釘下了命運的定局。

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: 潮游國度
programme.desc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸。這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地，受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊，又暴露在酷熱中。這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化。 科學家們探索這個外星之境。

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E3 -Rocco, Harold and Cindy
programme.desc: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

programme.title: 第3集 - 羅科、哈羅德、辛蒂
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特，她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德，並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時，感受愛意。稍後，在羅科袋熊重返野外時，帶著情感道別。

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal S2E4 -Milton, Cash and Bentley
programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkey’s birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: 第4集 - 米爾頓、凱許、本特利
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝，接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏。認識海狸比約納，他有一份非常重要的工作，並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E5 -Chasing Scales
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: 第5集 - 追逐鱗影
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區，馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅。觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出，傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去，而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室，確保屋主生活區域的安全。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E6 -Home Invasion
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: 第6集 - 入侵家園
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時，米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇。傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出，而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時，更令人心跳加速、驚慌不已。

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E6 -Buffalo Showdown
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: 第6集 - 水牛對決
programme.desc: 對獅子來說，水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐，但同時也是危險的獵物。與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛，並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧，他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動。

programme.title: Gecko's Garage S1E2 -A Busy Day at the Garage!
programme.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles & needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: Little Angel S7E5 -Jill's Artsy August Masterpiece
programme.desc: Express yourself this Artsy August! Join Jill as she learns to handle frustration when her painting goes wrong. Then, join a sled race, discover your own special talent, and decorate a pair of super sparkly new shoes!

programme.title: Little Angel S7E4 -Jill & Baby John's Art of Repair
programme.desc: Be a creative doctor this Artsy August! After a doll accidentally breaks, help Baby John and Jill set up a hospital to fix her. Then, help a lost starfish get back to the sea and drive a pretend bus through the garden.

programme.title: ARPO S3E1 -When Arpo's Imagination Runs Wild!
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house & needs to be stopped!

programme.title: ARPO S3E2 -The Ultimate Arpo vs Squirrel Showdown!
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo & his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie & tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S2E3 -The Ultimate Outdoor Play Day!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate outdoor play day! Mummy & Daddy take the kids to the park to fly colorful Japanese koinobori kites. Then, Mia & Max head to the pond to feed the ducks, but are shocked to find there are no ducks there! They must go on an adventure to find them. The outdoor fun continues as Mummy sets up a painting session in the park, where the kids have fun discovering new colors with their fingers, hands & feet!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S10E1 -Stan's Artsy August
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August dress-up party! Pretend to be anything you can imagine. Dive under the sea to count colorful fish, make yummy pancakes in different shapes, and cheer on Mia as she learns to ride her two-wheel bike!

programme.title: Morphle S4E6 -Mila & Chroma's August Splat-tacular
programme.desc: Get set for an Artsy August adventure! Race with Mila and Morphle in a hot air balloon against tricky racers. Then, help them find a cure for a sneezing Chroma who is covering the city in paint, and join a wild, musical talent show chase!

programme.title: Morphle S2E5 -Morphle's Artsy August Attack!
programme.desc: Join an Artsy August adventure! Help Mila and Morphle repaint the city after Chroma steals its colors. Then, build a wild treehouse with magic pets, race in a dinosaur triathlon, and win the big Petport Rally!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E22 -JJ's Artsy August Class
programme.desc: Get creative for Artsy August! Join Ms. Appleberry's class to learn how red, blue, and yellow Jello can mix to make purple, orange, and green. Then, transform toy cars with a splash of paint and learn how to tap dance to the beat!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E24 -Cody's Artsy August Music Makers
programme.desc: Make music this Artsy August! Discover amazing sounds as Cody's dad plays African instruments. Then, play with an empty cardboard box, go on a rainbow flower scavenger hunt, and dance with adorable baby animals at the zoo!

programme.title: Minibods S1E2 -Drawing, Painting, Music & A Quick Fix!
programme.desc: The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music & a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing & crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird & Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

programme.title: Minibods S1E8 -Party Time, Win, Wait & Eat Greens!
programme.desc: It's a day of learning lessons at parties & games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere & not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair & Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S2E3 -Fun Nature Discoveries!
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he & D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made & join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science & new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S2E1 -Awesome Animal Facts!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He & D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, & even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool & discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E3 -Wonders Of The World & Beyond!
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world & beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi & FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon & discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E17 -JJ's Active Adventures & Fun!
programme.desc: It's time to move & groove with JJ's active adventures! Ms. Appleberry teaches the importance of stretching & exercise. Then, JJ learns Taekwondo & earns his first belt! The active fun continues as the kids learn to tap dance & play on the jungle gym. Plus, join JJ & his family for a super fun beach day, making sandcastles & playing in the sea, & an exciting backyard camping trip!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E1 -A Fun School Day with JJ & Friends!
programme.desc: Join JJ & his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks & drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses & how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day & enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning & fun!

programme.title: Little Angel S7E2 -So Many Fun Questions to Ask!

programme.desc: Chemical sprays are making the countryside rosy! The Barbapapas' build an aviary to protect sick birds. // When they see a beach covered with rubbish, the Barbapapa family decides to clean the beach and use the trash to make a miniature golf course.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories With Ryan S1E106 -Goodnight &, Hello, Do
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are fully dressed.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1E112 -The Secret Of The Sand Serpent/The Disappearance Of Peggy Scratch
programme.desc: Sam and Kit save a town from being pulled underground by a legendary serpent. // The pals search for their team leader after crashing during a flight test.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1E113 -The Forest Food Bandit/The Case Of The Absent Giraffe
programme.desc: No one's food is safe in the forest when a mysterious thief nabs everyone's supply. // Sam and Kit are on the case when Gordy the giraffe goes missing.

programme.title: Deer Squad S3E311 -Treasure Ship/Sleepover On Sparkle Island
programme.desc: Bobbi mistook Sir Steel's sparkly anchor for a treasure. Sir Steel's Jelly Surprise then spilled into the waters! // Adventure Alex takes Deer Squad and the twins to camp and search for the mysterious Grax Turtle on Sparkle Island.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E834 -In The Future
programme.desc: Charlotte Sheep is babysitting her cousin Suzy Sheep and her best friend Peppa. Peppa and Suzy are excited at their sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are all grown up.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E835 -Doctor Hamster's Big Present
programme.desc: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. Dr Hamster wishes she could exercise more, so Grampy Rabbit decides to build something to help...

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E836 -Butterflies
programme.desc: Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. The children paint caterpillars, make butterfly wings and even dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E837 -Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
programme.desc: It's snowing and Grampy Rabbit has built a jetpack. While showing it to Peppa and George, he shoots off into the distance ending up on top of a snowy mountain. Miss Rabbit goes to rescue him, but Grampy Rabbit is the one that rescues them all.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1E114 -The Elf Windmill/The Elf Band
programme.desc: Mr Elf demonstrates why it takes so long to make flour, but Nanny Plum refuses to wait, and uses magic to speed up the elf windmill. // Holly and her parents try to impress Snobby King and Queen Marigold with help from the elf band.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S8E824 -Pups Save A Lonesome Walrus/Pups Save The Hummy Gummies
programme.desc: Wally the Walrus searches all over Adventure Bay for Cap'n Turbot and turns the town upside-down in the process. // Everybody loves Helga Humdinger's Hummy Gummy treats, causing Mayor Humdinger to get jealous and steal them all.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S11E1103 -Pups Save A Pet Show
programme.desc: Today is Adventure Bay's 'Twin It To win It' pet show, where owners and their pets dress in matching outfits.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2E220 -The Crew Builds A Post Office/The Crew Builds A Super Farm Animal Wash
programme.desc: Builder Cove needs a post office! But when construction gets squirrely, it's up to the pups to find a construction solution. // Rubble & Crew use their construction skills to convert the super car wash and clean Farmer Zoe's sticky farm animals.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1E113 -The Crew Builds A Wheelchair Ramp
programme.desc: When Omar the Mail Carrier breaks his foot, it's up to the pups to make sure he can still deliver the mail by building ramps all over town.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1E108 -Big Help Croc/Pom Pom
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile volunteers to help too many friends with their projects all at the same time. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile invite a new friend, PomPom, to live with them.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S2E205 -Ah! My Beautiful Castle/The Sand Is Running Away
programme.desc: During a bike ride, the Barbapapa family discovers an old medieval castle in ruins. // Barbapapa and Lolita were traveling in a balloon, but caught in a storm they ended up stranded on a deserted island.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S2E226 -The First Day Of School
programme.desc: Tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school.

programme.title: Dora S2E204 -The Floor Is Guava/We Are The Grumples
programme.desc: Boots wants to enjoy Banana Fest, but the Guava Geyser is erupting! Dora needs to stop the geyser and save the festival. / It's Picture Day, but the Grumpy Old Troll runs away! Dora follows him into Troll World to get him to come out for the picture.

programme.title: A Taxi Driver
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him...

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: In 2005, a high-profile case of a police officer who disappeared during a forest hike spawned urban legends about the existence of a gateway into another world. In 2016, those legends inspired popular internet novel Missing, which is now being adapted into an eerie supernatural thriller by first-time director and Fresh Wave alum Ronnie Chau. Former pop idol Gillian Chung stars as a social worker who hires a mountain guide to search for her missing father in the mountains. She discovers the mystical gateway from the urban legends, but is her father really waiting for her on the other side?

programme.title: My Missing Valentine (a.k.a One Second Ahead, One Second Behind)
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.

programme.title: Chang An
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.title: The Fatal Raid
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive...

programme.title: I Sell Love
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Kick to Achieve a Comeback Victory
programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. Gigi has burst out laughing when recalled funny scenes from the film. While Man Lung tells that he seemed like a scolded kid during a scene together with Gigi, Rachel also reveals a stunning reason of taking her role and Peter even names Gigi as a “new comedy star held up by romantic film”!

programme.title: Acting's No Kidding: Distinction
programme.desc: Ms Tsui is a music teacher in a special education needs (SEN) school, who is not able to switch to a mainstream school due to stereotyping and labelling; Zoey is an underachiever from a Band 1 school, who is struggling for the coming public examination; Ka Ho is a rebellious teenager from a Band 3 school, who idles away his time and doesn't care about his handicapped little brother...Fate drives the three to take part in a musical they deem worthless for their own purposes, which turns out to be a journey of self-discovery towards their dreams and goals.

programme.title: Baogu Select Music X Microfilm E264 -Memento Mori
programme.desc: Memento Mori follows four young friends who know their exact time of death. In the final hours of their countdown, they gather for a farewell party that belongs only to them. With laughter, confessions, and fragile honesty, they hold one another close, trying to preserve a last fragment of courage before fear takes over.As death approaches them one by one, every reaction-friendship, regret, and the pretenses they once hid behind-is laid bare under the unforgiving light of the end.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: This is a story between the mole in the police department, Ming(Andy Lau) and the undercover cop, Yan(Tony Leung), who are competing to uncover each other first...

programme.title: The Seventh Curse
programme.desc: Yuan Chen-ha saves Betsy from being sacrificed by the wicked priest in Thailand, but is stricken with seven blood curses. Soon, Yuan's veins start to burst, Wesley sends Yuan, Rainbow and Betsy's boy-friend back to find Buddha's Eye, which can cure Yuan. The wicked priest has directed the blood demon to attack Yuan and his friends. Wesley comes up with the weapons to destroy their wicked enemies...

programme.title: My Lucky Stars
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely...

programme.title: The Lion Roars
programme.desc: During Soong dynasty, there lived a beauty named Moth Liu. She has gone to blind dates for many times. Still she cannot get married, until she meets a talented poet Seasonal Chan. Seasonal is making his debut as Soo's special guest in a reading-concert, his avant-garde style is badly received, only Moth supports him whole heatedly. Not long afterwards the two get married, and only until then Seasonal realizes that he has married to a roaring lion who limits him on all his activities and expenses...

programme.title: Hocus Pocus
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence...

programme.title: Porky's Meatballs
programme.desc: A new school term begins. Vivacious high school girl Jane hurries back to Hong Kong from overseas, where she spent her vacation. Chinese-American college student Wan Ho follows her all the way to Hong Kong to get close to her. But Jane is so popular in school and is used to having boys around her. One of them is Tse Tin, the son of the school director. While Tse Tin and Wan Ho regard each other as rivals and fight over Jane all the time, Jane has developed a crush on the P.E. teacher! Meanwhile, Pak Yat Moon has a crush on Wan Ho, and Ka Ming has crush on Pak Yat Moon! It is a total mess and the relationships become utterly chaotic! Everything culminates in a showdown during a big basketball game...

programme.title: NIGHT LIFE HERO
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide?

programme.title: 1995 Collections: Twist
programme.desc: Wisdom thief Yam Ka Wa having girlfriend Ann as an inside accomplice, using high-tech techniques robbed the escort vehicle and stole one hundred and seventy million dollars. Crime Unit Chief Inspector Lee and his detectives working around the clock to detect, eventually discovered clues. They suspect that Wa and Ann were the mastermind of the case, but there was no evidence against them. Lee tried various methods of interrogation to no avail, finally has to resort to torture, but the two remain resolute, enduring the torture and recriminate Lee for police brutality...

programme.title: Winners And Sinners
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation...

programme.title: My Lucky Stars
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it...

programme.title: Tiger and Crane E14
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: The Truth Within E15
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: Nothing but You E12
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: Twenty Your Life On 2 E2
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: Asian Tour Highlights 2026 -Singapore Open presented by The Business Times
Voices of Youth E9 -《愛，很簡單》張新成超絕solo
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。

programme.title: Singing With Legends Season 6 (Repackaged) E6 -騰格爾張淇搖滾舞台好嗨
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴。

programme.title: Her Prime E3 -謝娜家庭聚餐全家飆戲
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣。

programme.title: Rap Star Dream Maker (Repackaged) E3 -GAI打破規則復活新星
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16 E29 -心跳飆至171 堅持心動激動落淚
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: A Dream Like The True Love (Mini drama) E2
programme.desc: 少女陳寶銀為救母親，無奈被卷入命運洪流，從青樓逃落後幾經輾轉成為船娘；在她最落魄時重逢曾救過她的書生溫肅，此時溫肅已家道中落，為救家人忍辱成為長公主的男寵；兩個身處泥潭的底層男女在亂世中相互取暖、彼此救贖，上演了一段充滿破碎感卻又堅韌動人的愛情故事。

programme.title: Princess Revenge (Mini drama) E9
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: Super Brain Season 12 E7 -9支隊伍上演搶積分大戰
